title: Meeting Rooms
statement: Given meeting intervals, return true when a person can attend every meeting. Meetings that touch at an endpoint do not conflict.
hints: A conflict is a meeting that starts before the previous meeting ends.
One linear check after the sort is enough.

approaches.name: Sort and adjacent check
approaches.explanation: Only neighbors in start order can be the first conflict.

editorial: If any two meetings overlap, the one with the earlier start overlaps the next one after sorting. So it is enough to compare each meeting with its predecessor. A start equal to the previous end is allowed.

examples.explanation: The long meeting covers the other two.
